title: Rank-9 realisations of the E8 pattern with extra zeros (≤ 3 per row and column) are B-form or A2: philippeVV's R1 in that regime (no κ claim)
body:
Package: `research/e8-rank9-extra-zeros/`. Pure matrix classification on the E8 unit. **No κ claim**, no window, no supplier, no decoder cost. It extends #2819 (rank-9 realisations with the full iff pattern are B-form or A2) to realisations that may have **zeros on non-orthogonal pairs**, and compares the result with philippeVV's normal forms and open item R1 (Discussion #1587, follow-ups 7, 8 and 9). **R1 for an arbitrary number of extra zeros is not claimed.**

Labels in the README: PROVEN / CHECKED (recomputed by `verify.sh`; SAT steps are kissat 4.0.4 UNSAT with a DRAT proof accepted by the standard drat-trim) / RECORDED / CONDITIONAL.

## Results

1. **Bridge to philippeVV's R1 / R2 (PROVEN; 12 exact members CHECKED).** Every B-form realisation (any `supp c`, `supp β`, singular `D` allowed) is a member of their κ-family (expSM Proposition 0) and is a lift with R2 in the per-`N` form; every A2-family member equals their `a2lib` normal form; conversely {B-form} = {κ-family} after `N_aa = 1`. The README states how this relates to the definition of lift in follow-up 7 (agreement with a torus orbit of `G/2` except on odd pairs touching a pairwise-odd `S`), under which R1 is not vacuous; that their R2 is universal rigidity on `T` while the per-`N` root-realisation form is what the Lift Lemma uses; and that when `A` and `B` both contain orthogonal pairs, `S = B` is a lift only in the §4 / R3 sense (the κ-family form is unaffected). Non-concurrency occurs only on A2 triangles.
2. **Theorem Z3′ (PROVEN from CHECKED).** If every row and every column of a rank-9 realisation of the E8 pattern (characteristic 0) contains at most 3 extra zeros, with no bound on the total, then it is B-form (`D` singular at most on a clique inside `supp c ∩ supp β`) or A2. With the bridge: **R1 with R2 in the per-`N` form holds in this regime** (universal R2 is proved only for clique complements, item 3). Its hypotheses cover those of the earlier results for one exceptional row or column with at most 3 zeros and for a total of at most 3 extra zeros (not their conclusions: Z3's is sharper), and it uses Theorem G with singular scalings (G⁻, G^K); the earlier results Z1 (any number of zeros in one row or column) and Z3 (at most one singular scaling for a total of at most 3) are kept with their inputs.
3. **Theorem RK (PROVEN from CHECKED).** Rank-8 completions on `E8 ∖ C`, `C` any clique, with arbitrary extra zeros, have no extra zero and are root realisations (`D₁GD₂`): universal R2 for clique complements. Two zero-pattern CNFs (8-clique and maximal 7-clique complements) are kissat UNSAT with drat-trim VERIFIED proofs shipped; both regenerate byte-identically; the negative control (goal clause dropped) is SAT; `W(E8)` is transitive on maximal cliques of each size; A2 triangles by rigidity on `E8 ∖` triangle.

## What remains (stated exactly in README §5)

R1 with arbitrarily many extra zeros. The proof uses the per-line budget in three places only (a frame row or column with ≥ 8 extra zeros; the step `Π(+) ≠ Π(−)`; "no pure off-frame column"), and the SAT residue step is certified for at most 3 extra zeros per row and column. The first uncovered configuration is a pure line, which Lemma PL (PROVEN) shows is a clique.

## Verification

`bash research/e8-rank9-extra-zeros/verify.sh` from a fresh `git archive`: manifest; exact finite facts (spans, P-compatible frames, clique spans and orbits, bridge members, rigidity on `E8 ∖` triangle, frame choice, P-compatibility on `E8 ∖` clique); byte-identical regeneration of the five CNFs; the four shipped DRAT proofs (`.drat.xz`, 36.6 MB in total) checked by drat-trim. `FULL=1` adds fresh kissat solves with fresh drat-trim checks and the negative control. kissat only (never CaDiCaL); one heavy process at a time under `nice -n 10`, every external call under `timeout 1200`.

## Credit and scope notes

The κ-family normal form, lifts, the `a2lib` normal form, the R1 to R4 formulation and the census are philippeVV's (artifact `integer-mult-bounds` @ 93766d7d, `decoder-law/lift-family-2` and expSM; follow-up 9's Theorem R3, lifts on dependent or non-clique supports of at most 26 lines are κ-family members, @ b5ce9d22 `closures-3/decoder-law-subsets`). Our R3 remark is a normal-form statement for Gram `T`-rows only and does not extend their range; this package compares normal forms and does not run their code. The audit is by the same author's tooling (independent read-only reviews), not a human review.
